description: Normative proof-codec profile (CN-56, revisions 23-24). Every hex-blob evidence field in the envelope is opaque to the offline suite, but its framing is part of the wire contract: two conforming deployments must encode the SAME evidence into the SAME bytes. This document maps every such field to a codec NAME, and (revision 24) every codec name to its DEFINITION: the governing serialization source at a pinned commit for Dash Core codecs, or the governing protobuf/proof types resolved through the envelope's own version pins for Platform codecs. The document is content-addressed at the release layer (sha256 pinned in the vector manifest, re-checked every suite run); any change to a mapping or definition mints tegara-proof-codecs-v2 or bumps envelopeVersion.

definitions.dash-tx-serialization-v1: the Dash transaction wire serialization at 8c9f166a3:src/primitives/transaction.h (CTransaction::SerializeOp), including the DIP-2 extra payload
definitions.dash-merkle-branch-v1: the Dash coinbase Merkle branch as CPartialMerkleTree at 8c9f166a3:src/merkleblock.h
definitions.dash-smlentry-serialization-v1: the CSimplifiedMNListEntry wire serialization at 8c9f166a3:src/evo/simplifiedmns.h (consensus fields only; scriptPayout/payouts/scriptOperatorPayout are mem-only and NOT serialized, the CN-57 evidence-reality fact)
definitions.dash-clsig-v1: the ChainLock signature message llmq::CChainLockSig at 8c9f166a3:src/llmq/clsig.h
definitions.dash-quorum-commitment-v1: the LLMQ final commitment llmq::CFinalCommitment at 8c9f166a3:src/llmq/commitment.h
definitions.dash-header-chain-v1: a header-COUNT prefix (u32 little-endian) followed by that many consecutive 80-byte Dash CBlockHeader wire serializations (8c9f166a3:src/primitives/block.h), ascending height
definitions.dash-script-serialization-v1: raw Dash script bytes as in CTxOut scriptPubKey at 8c9f166a3:src/primitives/transaction.h (no length prefix; the JSON hex is the script bytes themselves)
definitions.tenderdash-protobuf-header-v1: the tendermint.types.Header protobuf message as pinned by the PROOF-VERIFIER BUNDLE (below)
definitions.tenderdash-commit-v1: the tendermint.types.Commit protobuf message, resolved as above
definitions.tenderdash-validator-set-v1: the tendermint.types.ValidatorSet protobuf message, resolved as above
definitions.tenderdash-validator-transition-v1: the ordered tendermint.types.ValidatorSet transition proof chain, resolved as above
definitions.tenderdash-tx-merkle-proof-v1: the tendermint.crypto.Proof transaction Merkle proof, resolved as above
definitions.tenderdash-trust-root-v1: the pinned initial validator-set hash as tendermint.types.ValidatorSet hash bytes, resolved as above
definitions.platform-state-transition-v1: the Dash Platform state-transition serialization as pinned by the PROOF-VERIFIER BUNDLE (below), consistent with the lineage's platformProtocolVersion
definitions.drive-grovedb-proof-v1: the Drive GroveDB proof format as pinned by the PROOF-VERIFIER BUNDLE (below)

codecs.checkpoints[].signedPayloadBytes: tegara-fixedslot-checkpoint-v2 (the pinned layout of the design note, decoded by the suite itself)

proofVerifierBundle.requirement: Every Platform-side codec above (tenderdash-*, platform-*, drive-*) is DEFINED by the deployment's PROOF-VERIFIER BUNDLE: a content-addressed bundle (a leaf OCI image-manifest digest or equivalent, published in the deployment's verifier release manifest alongside this profile's hash) whose OWN manifest pins the exact source revisions (dashpay/tenderdash, dashpay/platform) and the deterministic framing rules (deterministic protobuf marshaling, unknown-field REJECTION, and every length-prefix convention) for each codec. platformProtocolVersion alone does NOT identify a unique release (multiple releases implement one protocol version) and protobuf type names alone do NOT pin deterministic serialization; the bundle digest is what completes the commitment, and the ENVELOPE CARRIES IT (revision 26): the required top-level verifierBundleDigest field commits which bundle interprets this envelope's proof blobs, so two deployments sharing this profile but using different bundles produce DIFFERENT envelope bytes. The bundle is a build artifact, so this profile cannot pin one digest pre-build; the envelope-level commitment is the closure, and the runtime duty is that the deployment's actual bundle hashes to the serialized digest. environmentDigest commits ONLY the transaction-decoder environment and is NOT this bundle.
proofVerifierBundle.revision: revision 26, the final CN-56 closure (the envelope-level verifierBundleDigest commitment)

runtimeVerifierDuties: each verifier decodes its evidence fields with EXACTLY the codec this profile defines for them; an undecodable blob removes AUTHENTICATED from the owning component
a producer serializes each evidence field with the same defined codec, so byte-identical envelopes follow from identical evidence

for the Platform codecs, the deployment's PROOF-VERIFIER BUNDLE (above) pins the exact source revisions and framing rules; its digest is published with the verifier release, and verification under any other bundle is a different deployment
